acceptance.artifact: atomically issued fence tokens plus a concurrent multi-process recurrence test
acceptance.assertion: A fence token is issued at most once per unit, guaranteed under concurrency rather than by convention. Proven by concurrent multi-process lease grants for the same unit where every granted lease carries a distinct, strictly increasing fence token and any loser is refused and durably recorded. Reproduced by the coordinator on 2026-08-22: three concurrent grants all minted fence token 1, so three holders shared one fence. Note this is a distinct invariant from ledger sequence-number uniqueness in a11-u02: the chain verified clean while fence uniqueness broke, so a11-u02 passing does not imply this unit passes.
acceptance.falsified_if: any two lease grants for one unit can share a fence token, or a refused grant leaves no durable record

hypothesis: cmd_lease reads the current fence token, computes its successor and appends in three unsynchronised steps, so concurrent lease grants for the same unit mint identical fence tokens and the fencing mechanism can no longer distinguish one holder from another.
